_doc: Travel and trade between the settlements of the region (docs/gdd/09b_region.md, decisions of 2026-11-04: O-R2 a, O-R3 a, O-R4 c, O-R5 a, O-R6 c, O-R7 a, O-R8 a). Read by sim/region/*.gd (Region, Travel, CityTrade, Caravans, Treaties); the places, routes and identity are in region.json. Every figure is [balance], provisional. Nothing here touches the home town: a family that never travels nor sends a caravan meets none of these rules (its rolls are keyed streams of their own, never state.rng).

travel._doc: unlock_title: the social title that opens travelling (O-R2 a). The route's hours × the events' errands multiplier (the war's «rutas cortadas», ×1.5). A route whose cut_by event is in force (home's events_active or the regional events of «regional_events») cannot be taken. toll: gold per leg, the route's «toll» in region.json. escort: gold per leg; divides the ambush chance. ambush_per_risk: chance of an ambush per leg without escort = risk × this. An ambush takes every item the traveller carries (no wound until the health of 4.22 arrives: H12.3). gate: the spawn the traveller leaves by and comes back to.

city_market._doc: The market of a settlement away from home (9b.5): price = base_price × quality × demand_city × season × the regional events (home's season-scope events in force) × the city's own local events × mod_city (its «cheap» / «dear» in region.json, by item or goods group, multiplied) × buy_price_mult of the difficulty (buying) or sell_ratio (selling). The demand of each city moves like home's (data/market.json demand: drop_per_unit for each unit sold there, recover_per_day at dawn towards rest). The city's tariff (region.json) is taken from what an outsider sells there, unless an exemption treaty covers the family. What it trades: every item with a market_stall.
city_market._quality_premium_doc: Equilibrio 7 (docs/decisiones.json): by settlement kind, what a sale pays more per step of quality (good 1, excellent 2): price × (1 + premium × quality). The capital prizes good work.

reputation._doc: Reputation of each family in each settlement away from home (O-R7 a), in [min, max], 0 at first. Home's reputation (4.10.5) never moves with it. sale: what each sale_units units sold there give (counted across sales). Equilibrio 7 (2026-11-05): 1 per unit (was 1 per 2) and 5 per contract done (was 3), so the trips and the contracts there build the reputation a treaty asks, not only the caravans.

board._doc: Contracts of the cities (9b.5, «encargos de fuera»): at dawn each city may post one (chance) while it has fewer than max_open; the item is one of its «dear» items (or of its dear goods groups), qty in [qty_min, qty_max], the reward = base_price × qty × reward_mult, due in days_min..days_max days. Accepting needs to be there (or a caravan heading there); delivering, the goods there (the traveller or a caravan). Rolls keyed by city and day.

caravans._doc: O-R4 c: a family buys a cart (cart_price, upkeep per day at dawn, capacity in stacks) and sends it with one of its employees (the carter: away while it goes) to a city by the shortest open way, with a cargo from one of its buildings (each item with a minimum unit price: below it, it does not sell) and a shopping list (each item with a maximum unit price and a quantity). It sells, buys, stays stay_hours and comes back to the building it left from. Each leg rolls its ambush like a trip (escort optional, per leg); an ambush takes the cargo, never the cart. The carter's wage goes on as at home.

ai_caravans._doc: Abstract caravans of the AI families (9b.5, «con las familias rivales»): at the start of each season, each AI family with a production building rolls chance (keyed stream); with a hit, it «sells» qty units of what its building makes in a city (keyed pick): the city's demand of that item drops qty × drop_per_unit. No gold, no orders, no agenda (04c untouched). An exclusivity treaty keeps the item out.

treaties._doc: The three treaties of 9b.5 (O-R6 c). title: the social title the signer's family needs; reputation: in that city; seasons: how long it lasts; fee: gold at signing. exemption: no tariff there. exclusivity (item): only the family sells that item there (the AI caravans leave it). quota (item): the city buys qty units a season at price_mult × base_price, no tariff; at the end of each season with fewer delivered: breach (penalty gold, the reputation's treaty_broken, the treaty ends). Each season kept: treaty_kept. A family treaty is signed by its head (or the regent) in the city. A town treaty (scope «town», exemption only) is proposed by the Mayor and voted by the council (the mayor and the councillors: a councillor votes yes if its affinity with the mayor is >= council_yes_affinity; the mayor's vote breaks ties); it covers every family of home and gives the mayor town_reputation at home. Equilibrio 7b (2026-11-06, docs/gdd/09b_region.md §9b.12) [balance]: the quota pays 1,5 × base (was 1,2: it paid less than the capital's own market, 78 against ~81 after tariff) and asks reputation 3 there (was 5: a first trip with 3 swords signs it).

regional_events._doc: O-R8 a: the events of the region that cut routes (not in data/events.json: they would move its rolls and today's targets). At the start of each season one keyed roll per event (its own stream, «rgev»), from min_day; it lasts the season. cuts: the route terrains it closes (region.json routes terrain). They touch nothing at home.

city_events._doc: The local events of each city away from home: every day one keyed roll per city («rgev|<city>») over the local-scope events of data/events.json with chance × chance_mult; their price and demand effects touch only that city's market. At most one at a time per city.
